description: Fork of exp507 (hybrid: soft MatmulMHLut qkv + argmax TinyMHLut v/out/residual, 1.4832). Two changes: (1) qkv_lut -> qk_lut: drop the additive shallow v-branch, qk_lut now outputs only 2*d_qk (q,k); v comes solely from v_lut. (2) v_lut tph 256 -> 320 to compensate for the removed v-branch capacity. Tests whether a clean q/k-only soft projection + slightly fatter dedicated v_lut matches/beats the shared-anchor v-branch design. Optimizer split unchanged: qk_lut (dense) -> AdamW wd=0.1, v/out/residual (sparse) -> LION. vs exp507 1.4832, exp475 1.4962, exp493 1.4806.
